Get codeminer metadata

Source: R/database-utils.R
get_codeminer_metadata.Rd

Returns metadata about the lookup, mapping, and relationship tables in the codeminer database.

Usage

get_codeminer_metadata(type = c("lookup", "mapping", "relationship"))

Arguments

type

The type of metadata to return. By default returns a list containing all metadata types. Otherwise, returns a data frame for the specified type. Must be one of "lookup", "mapping" or "relationship".

Value

If a single type is requested, a data frame. If multiple types are requested, a named list of data frames.

Examples

create_dummy_database()
